integrity: The Nijenhuis equations are reconstructed from the C3 multiplication, the automorphism group is derived directly, and the orbit reduction follows from an explicit block conjugation action. A standalone symbolic checker replays the defining equations, automorphism identities, conjugation formulas, and all seven normal-form families.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the complex associative algebra C3 from the cited classification.
The orbit list uses an isotropic basis available over the complex numbers and is not asserted unchanged over arbitrary fields.
A specialized or unindexed source may contain an equivalent conjugacy calculation.
title: Automorphism normal forms for Nijenhuis operators on the \(C_3\) associative algebra
